column1: Factors affecting income tax expense for the year
Income tax expense difers to the standard rate of corporation tax as follows:
Tax on profit at Australian prima facie tax rate of 30 per cent
Non-tax effected operating losses and capital gains:
Tax on remitted and unremitted foreign earnings
Tax effectof lossfrom equity accounted investments, related impairments and expenses(2)
Impact of tax rates applicable outside of Australia
Royalty-related taxation (net of income tax benefit)
